notes_for_editor: Thin record. The NHLR registration (nominated by Andrew Zerbe) is the only substantive source, and its condition details date from the 2016 nomination. The Forest Lookouts Moreland page carries only a National Geodetic Survey station record with no descriptive text. Two searches for Forest Service project records, a Wikipedia article on the forest and a towers directory produced no history and were not fetched or used. Build year 1933 follows the NHLR. The 1819 News column is used only for statewide context. Current condition and public access are unknown. The earlier access level 'restricted' was not supported by any source and has been removed; the 2016 missing stairs are recorded in the visit note only. The NHLR photo credit (Billy Wayne White) has no image URL captured, so no photo entry was added.
